svg.title: IntrMotiv architecture using supplied elements
svg.desc: The supplied visual encoder, DG, CA3, readout, action and environment artwork forms a compact top flow. A short label identifies DG as a learned sparse projection and CA3 as a fixed shift register. Below it are the supplied DG sparsifier, CA3 temporal traces, and red and blue learning formulas.
svg.text: DG: learned sparse projection → CA3: fixed shift register
